cases.title: Three arrested after robbery in Patna
cases.body: Police on Monday arrested three men in connection with a jewellery shop robbery. All stolen items were recovered, officials said.

cases.title: Bihar Police receives modernisation funding
cases.body: The state government has approved a Rs 750 crore modernisation programme for the police. Cyber laboratories will come up in all ranges under the funded programme.

cases.title: Bihar approves Rs 750 crore police modernisation programme
cases.body: The cabinet approved the modernisation programme covering cyber labs, weapons and mobility. The home department will review funding utilisation every quarter.

cases.title: Minister attacks opponent at election rally
cases.body: Addressing a rally, the minister attacked the opposition over stalled works. Party workers cheered the rhetoric while opposition leaders hit out in return.

cases.title: Cabinet approves industrial policy
cases.body: The cabinet approved a new industrial policy offering capital subsidy and stamp duty waivers. The industries department will allot land on priority.

cases.title: Bridge collapses one year after construction
cases.body: An under-construction bridge over the river collapsed on Thursday. The road construction department ordered a probe into the collapse of the structure.

cases.title: CAG finds major expenditure irregularities
cases.body: The auditor general flagged irregularities of Rs 400 crore in rural road schemes. The CAG report cites excess payments and incomplete works.

cases.title: Major communal violence disrupts a district
cases.body: Communal clashes left several injured as violence spread across neighbourhoods. The administration imposed curfew and suspended internet services.

cases.title: Celebrity relationship controversy involving a Bihar-born actor
cases.body: The actor's relationship became the talk of celebrity gossip columns after photos surfaced. Film fans debated the controversy on social media.

cases.title: Bihar Cabinet approves Patna Metro expansion
cases.body: The cabinet cleared two metro corridors to Bihta. The revised detailed project report enables tenders for the construction expansion early next year.

cases.title: Candidates file nominations on last day
cases.body: Hundreds of candidates filed nomination papers as campaigning intensified. The manifesto promises dominated roadshow speeches across constituencies.

cases.title: Three injured in road accident
cases.body: Two vehicles collided on the national highway in a road accident. The injured were admitted to hospital after the collision.

cases.title: Twelve killed as bus overturns
cases.body: Twelve passengers were killed and twenty injured after the bus overturned on the highway. Rescue teams rushed the dead and injured to hospital.

cases.title: High Court directs forensic audit of civic funds
cases.body: The Patna High Court directed a forensic audit and pulled up the department. The bench issued the court order during the petition hearing.

cases.title: Court grants bail in theft case
cases.body: The court granted bail to the accused in a theft case. The hearing lasted twenty minutes before the judge pronounced the order.

cases.title: Light rain likely for two days, says forecast
cases.body: The weather department forecast light rain with a dip in maximum temperature. The monsoon remains active over the region.

cases.title: Floods displace 40,000 in north Bihar
cases.body: Floods marooned hundreds of villages as embankments faced pressure. Relief camps house the displaced while boats evacuate families.

cases.title: Bihar loses Ranji match by six wickets
cases.body: Chasing 240, the team folded for 180 in the second innings. The captain blamed poor shot selection after the match.

cases.title: Bhojpuri film releases in 200 theatres
cases.body: The much-awaited Bhojpuri film opened to packed houses. The actor thanked fans as box office numbers poured in.

cases.title: Opinion: why the city chokes every winter
cases.body: In my view, enforcement fails every winter as dust and smoke return. This column argues for year-round dust control, in my view the only fix.

cases.title: What the data says about land disputes
cases.body: This analysis of tribunal records shows disputes fell by a third. The data shows ground-truthing works, explains this explainer.

cases.title: Cabinet approves river project, says release
cases.body: According to an official release, the cabinet committee approved the interlinking project. The release said central assistance covers sixty percent.

cases.title: Twelve officers transferred, says notification
cases.body: A notification transferred twelve officers across districts. The official release lists the new postings without further detail.

cases.title: In pictures: festival preparations
cases.body: Photo gallery: glimpses from the ground as preparations peak. Top shots from our photographers in this pictures roundup.

cases.title: The right tractor for your farm
cases.body: Sponsored content: this partner content presents the new tractor range. Advertisement features easy loans for buyers.

cases.title: Community meeting held in village
cases.body: Residents gathered on Sunday to discuss local matters. Sweets were distributed at the end of the meeting.

cases.title: Daily horoscope: promising day for investments
cases.body: Aries natives may find gains today. Taurus should avoid travel. Check the rashifal before deciding.

cases.title: पटना मेट्रो विस्तार को मंजूरी
cases.body: राज्य कैबिनेट ने मेट्रो परियोजना के विस्तार को मंजूरी दी। बिहटा तक कॉरिडोर बनेगा और निर्माण के लिए निविदाएं आएंगी।

cases.title: पटना में लूट के बाद तीन गिरफ्तार
cases.body: पुलिस ने लूट के आरोप में तीन आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार किया। प्राथमिकी दर्ज कर लूटा गया सामान बरामद हुआ।

cases.title: रैली में विपक्ष पर बरसे मंत्री
cases.body: चुनावी रैली में मंत्री ने विपक्ष पर बयानबाजी का आरोप लगाया। पार्टी कार्यकर्ताओं ने जमकर नारेबाजी की।

cases.title: Midday meal menu revised in schools
cases.body: The education department revised the menu under the nutrition scheme. Eggs twice a week were approved for government schools.
